system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.

Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Model this mission for a contact-rich manipulation system named ParallelGripInsertB: Align a cylindrical peg with a hole having 1 mm radial clearance and insert at least 0.06 m without jamming. The physical system is as follows. A fixed 6 kg palm supports two 0.5 kg opposing box fingers on prismatic joints with 0.05 m travel and compliant pads. Two bounded linear finger actuators regulate closure and the allowed command magnitude is 36.9 N-per-finger. Set contact friction to 0.35 and represent both peg and fixture with rigid collision. Instrument the scenario as follows: Use joint or carriage sensing plus a six-axis contact wrench measurement. Control it using Cartesian impedance control with bounded insertion speed. During the middle third, inject a controlled 7 N lateral fixture load disturbance. Run at 100 Hz for 10 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Require actuator bounds, lateral and axial force limits, peg tilt, and insertion depth, primary tracking error below 0.002 m alignment after 6.5 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
